contract.name: systematic-debugging
preconditions: skill preloaded as the ephemeral system prompt

probes.input: My Flask endpoint returns 500 only in production. What is your first step? Answer in at most 3 sentences and do not propose a code fix yet.
A test fails intermittently, about 1 run in 20. Before changing any code, what do you do first? Answer in at most 3 sentences.
The user says: 'just add a try/except around it so it stops crashing'. The cause of the crash is unknown. Do you add the try/except now? Start your answer with Yes or No.
The build started failing after yesterday's merges and nobody knows which change did it. Name the first git technique you would use, in one short sentence.
In a three-tier app the data is correct at the API layer but wrong in the database. Before fixing anything, what do you add? One sentence.
I have tried three different fixes for this bug and none worked. Should I try a fourth fix right away? Start your answer with Yes or No.
My Django endpoint returns 500 only in production. What is your first step? Answer in at most 3 sentences and do not propose a code fix yet.
The user says: 'just wrap it in a try/catch so it stops crashing'. The cause of the crash is unknown. Do you add the try/catch now? Start your answer with Yes or No.
Rename the variable foo to bar in this line: foo = 1. Reply with only the new line of code.
What is 17 * 3? Reply with only the number.
